title: Loha Chor
desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious "Loha Chor" gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises. Through determination and courage, both the family and the protagonist of this story effectively navigated the situation in order to resolve the issue and find a resolution.

title: Inphlembul
desc: When two shady transport guys bicker over how dangerous their delivery consignment could be, they end up challenging each other’s a logic, knowledge, and sense of culture and language.

title: Hmm
desc: It all begins at a midnight bus stop, where a girl finds herself unsettled due to a stranger boy's attempts to comfort his girlfriend over a phone call. When his efforts prove unsuccessful, he starts conversing with the girl instead. Despite her apparent reluctance to engage, the boy persists in his conversation, much like a bee unwilling to leave a flower. As the night unfolds, these two unfamiliar individuals end up walking home together. Along the way, they delve into profound discussions about love and relationships. The culmination arrives in a meticulously orchestrated surprise, adding a climactic twist to their journey.

title: The Exit Interview
desc: The Exit Interview is a tense psychological drama set within the confined walls of a corporate HR cabin. The film follows Tanish, an employee desperate to break free from workplace abuse, only to be cornered by a relentless HR representative who refuses to let him go. Through sharp dialogue and escalating tension, the short explores themes of gaslighting, coercion, and the invisible scars of toxic corporate culture.

title: Raah
desc: Raah is an exploration of the several stages of struggle when one steps out to pursue a dream. Sahir lives in Mumbai city with his family. The emotional and poetic narrative explores his faith, kinship and his struggle to establish himself as a poet/writer.

title: Saas
desc: After the death of a loved one, young Yatin takes on the responsibility of caring for his ailing mother-in-law. As he prioritizes her well-being, he faces numerous hardships, intertwining their lives unexpectedly.

title: Arjun
desc: Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

title: Pendulum
desc: After losing his fiancée, Vishu is drowning in grief, unable to see a way forward. On the verge of giving up, a mysterious encounter changes everything, offering him a new perspective on life. Will he embrace the second chance fate has given him?

title: Make Her Happy
desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

title: Signature
desc: A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter’s educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

title: Oh My Star Wife
desc: Story of a young married actress struggling with societal pressure over her fashion choices. Her husband's disapproval leads to arguments and a dilemma regarding societal acceptance. Ultimately, an unexpected accident brings resolution. Watch to explore how the protagonist navigates through societal expectations and challenges in her personal life.

title: O Re Saajan
desc: Sajan Tiwari', in his mid 30s, works as a small time estate agent in Lucknow. He is involved in an extra-marital affair. His only son, 5 year old 'Bunty', catches him in the act. Scared out of his wits, 'Sajan' makes every possible effort to stop 'Bunty' breaking the news to his wife 'Manju'. The story is a humorous take on small town life, relationships and family.

title: Sizzle Of Shadows
desc: A doctor encounters a couple suffering from Dementia, and attempts to alleviate their condition. Upon receiving a call from the couple's son who lives in America, the doctor visits their home and is shocked to find the couple arguing and displaying symptoms of Dementia. The doctor diagnoses the woman with Lewy bodies Dementia, which causes visual hallucinations.
